meta.product: ILOSTAT STR DAYS: Days not worked due to strikes and lockouts by economic activity
meta.coverage: Days not worked due to strikes and lockouts by economic activity. Other - Special data collection, annual
meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: As published in ILOSTAT from: Other - Special data collection.
sourceNotes: Labour dispute actions coverage: Excluding political strikes (441 obs.)
Lower limit on coverage of strikes and lockouts: Excluding strikes with less than 10 workers (441 obs.)
